previous_attempts.error: the first launch attempt died in the first epoch on every rank: the level geometry and the measured radius were broadcast on the CPU and the NCCL backend has no CPU backend (RuntimeError: No backend type associated with device type cpu). The repair creates the broadcast tensors on the device; the mechanism tests pass after it.

the second launch attempt died in the first epoch on every rank with the same CPU-broadcast error: the rank-0 branch reassigned the measured radius to a CPU tensor, so the broadcast had no NCCL backend. The repair extracts the measurement into _measured_radius, which creates the tensor on the device, and the refresh does the same.

the third attempt reached epoch 150 and then spent fourteen minutes inside the first refresh: the exact transport problem on the real quotient has a far larger support than the proposal assumed, and the level-2 and level-3 quotients have hundreds of occupied prefixes. The repair caps the transport support at 48 cells, samples 32 edges per level and draws 3 null relabellings, and renormalises the measures over the capped support; the refresh now costs about four seconds for the three levels.

metrics.note: the run that finished is the manual four-rank probe of the repaired trainer; the same trainer, the same recipe, 3000 epochs
